newsitem.title: FRANCE: Acclaimed French historian Georges Duby dies at 77.
newsitem.headline: Acclaimed French historian Georges Duby dies at 77.

text.p: Georges Duby, one of France's greatest historians of the Middle Ages, died on Tuesday of cancer, his publishers Gallimard said. He was 77.
A prolific author and tireless researcher who brought mediaeval society to life in vivid studies of economic, rural and church life, Duby died at his home in Aix-en-Provence in southern France.

A professor at the prestigious College de France from 1970 until his retirement in 1992 and a member of the French Academy since 1987, Duby's acclaimed works included "The Age of Cathedrals", "Wars and Peasants" and best-sellers such as "The Knight, the Woman and the Priest".
